messages: kelly (Design): quick design sync — want to lock required-field affordance, multi-step validation UX, and the team-delete modal copy before we freeze the Settings spec. sam (PM): short list of options and a recommendation please. jordan (DevEx): cc a11y: screen reader hints, live regions, keyboard focus for summaries. linda (Eng): prefer one consistent visual pattern; extra variants cost QA time. kelly (Design): proposal A (micro-label): a small, subtle 'Required' pill after the label for things we truly need. proposal B (asterisk with legend) for long/dense forms. rationale: pills read clearly on mobile and avoid ambiguity. kelly (Design): example compact markup we discussed: ``` required ``` jordan (DevEx): pill works visually but ensure SR announces required state. add aria-required and sr-only text as in snippet. also ensure color contrast. linda (Eng): implementation note: pills are small DOM additions. legend vs pill toggling per form is fine but avoid per-field config booleans; make it a layout-level switch. kelly (Design): validation: single-step forms -> inline error under field. multi-step/wizard -> top compact banner: "2 problems on this page" with an expandable list of anchors. anchors jump to fields and shift focus. sam (PM): banner should show count and first invalid summary line; good for discoverability. also allow direct keyboard nav to each issue. jordan (DevEx): banner must be aria-live polite and when user activates an anchor it should move focus to the field and announce its label+error. include role=alert for explicit failures. linda (Eng): keep validation throttled to avoid full-form re-render on every keystroke. we can debounce and only update the banner when validation state stabilizes. kelly (Design): delete-team copy — options: short vs explicit. I'm leaning toward: Title: "Delete team and associated data" Body: "This will delete the team and all associated data. This action is irreversible. If your org uses soft-delete, items may be recoverable for 14 days." Confirmation: typed name match for org-level teams. sam (PM): prefer explicit language. mention restore window (14 days) since backend supports it. make typed confirm mandatory for teams with >50 members. jordan (DevEx): typed confirm a11y checklist: labelled input, clear instructions, mismatch error announced via role=alert, primary button disabled until match, and focus trap inside modal. linda (Eng): backend note: soft-delete for teams is 14 days; we keep an undo window for light deletes but typed confirm adds safety for big org actions. also avoid heavy API calls during typing by checking match client-side. ci-bot: branch created: feat/settings-validation-ui. PR: github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/589 kelly (Design): final call: adopt pill 'Required' for compact settings pages, legend for long forms, inline errors for single-step, compact banner with anchors for multi-step, and "Delete team and associated data" modal with typed-confirm for org-level + 14-day recovery messaging + undo toast for light deletes. I'll update the Figma file and write the acceptance criteria. sam (PM): I'll update the product doc and set a limit for when typed-confirm is required. jordan (DevEx): adding accessibility acceptance criteria to the ticket now. linda (Eng): noted perf guardrails and will review the PR. kelly (Design): thanks all 60a will ping when spec is ready for handoff.
